description: Check a list of items with quantities: orderable quantity per item, price, stock, delivery time, goods total, shipping options for that total, and a cart_url. The cart_url opens the puhy.cz cart with these items pre-filled in the user's browser, where the user completes checkout and payment. Suited to BOMs / parts lists: up to 50 lines per call; each cart_url adds its items to the same cart.
name: check_availability
title: Check availability & prepare cart
